content.text: The gateway restarted successfully and Slack reconnected. The tunnel has four active connections; I’m checking an inconsistent response from its public health endpoint.

Clanker’s gateway restarted successfully and reconnected to Slack.

The tunnel is up with **4 active connections**, and the public health check returns **HTTP 200**.
can I get to know if those 4 active connections are mine or what?
I’ll check what those four connections represent and whether they belong to your tunnel.

Yes, **all four belong to your Clanker tunnel running on your Mac**.

They’re connections from your Mac to Cloudflare’s servers, kept open for reliability. Cloudflare normally creates four so traffic can continue if a connection fails. [Cloudflare docs](https://developers.cloudflare.com/tunnel/configuration/)

**They don’t mean four people are connected or using Clanker.** The count measures the tunnel’s network links, not visitors or logged-in users.
